fusions.name: Eight at Once
fusions.desc: Looses 8 ink darts in a wide spread, each dealing 2 damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Ink Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a gout of ink that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and has a 60% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Backwash
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloud in the Water
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 40%, a ward absorbs damage equal to 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
